finding: service principal ec2.amazonaws.com with NO Condition
reason: EC2 does not send aws:SourceArn when an instance profile's role is assumed, so a SourceArn or SourceAccount condition would deny usms-web-01 its own credentials (Lab 09 Step 7 caveat).
compensating: Only usms-ec2-app-profile carries the role and only usms-web-01 wears it; IMDSv2 required with hop limit 1 (Step 11 - not applicable on Floci 1.5.34, must be applied on real AWS); USMSDeployBase denies iam:PassRole to ec2.amazonaws.com.

finding: service principal ec2.amazonaws.com with NO Condition
reason: EKS nodes are EC2 instances: the same instance-profile behaviour as usms-ec2-app-role, so the same condition would stop every node from joining the cluster.
compensating: IMDSv2 with hop limit 1 on the node launch template, so pods cannot reach the node's credentials; IRSA for usms-enrolment-sa (Lab 08 Exercise 5) to remove USMSStudentDataReadWrite from the node role.

finding: service principal eks.amazonaws.com with NO Condition
reason: Not verified which source keys EKS sends when it assumes the cluster role; a condition on a key that is never sent denies everything and would stop the control plane from managing the cluster.
compensating: Only eks.amazonaws.com may assume it, the cluster-sg admits tcp/443 from the VPC only, and USMSEKSClusterPolicy ends in a region Deny. Revisit once the EKS documentation for aws:SourceArn is checked.

finding: service principal edgelambda.amazonaws.com with NO Condition
reason: Lambda@Edge (Lab 10): CloudFront replicates and runs the function as edgelambda.amazonaws.com. Which source keys it sends is not verified, and a condition on a key that is never sent would stop every edge function. The lambda.amazonaws.com statement keeps its Lab 09 SourceAccount and SourceArn conditions.
compensating: The role's only permissions are USMSLambdaBasic (log writes, s3:GetObject); the edge functions get no other permission and USMSDeployBase may pass roles to ecs-tasks only.

finding: service principal edgelambda.amazonaws.com with NO Condition
reason: Same trust document as usms-lambda-exec-role (Lab 10 Exercise 2 reuses policies/trust-lambda-edge.json): edgelambda.amazonaws.com cannot be conditioned on keys it is not known to send.
compensating: USMSEdgeBasic grants log writes for usms-edge-* only - no S3, no other service - so a confused deputy gains nothing but the ability to write edge logs.
